title: Two Sum with Negative Numbers and Duplicates
statement: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target, considering negative numbers and duplicates.
hints: Use a dictionary to store the indices of the numbers and their negations
Iterate through the array and check if the difference between the target and the current number is in the dictionary
explanation: This variant adds the challenges of negative numbers and duplicates to the original problem.

title: Two Sum with Negative Numbers and Zero
statement: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target, with the constraint that the array contains negative numbers and zero.
constraints: The array contains negative numbers and zero
hints: Use a dictionary to store the numbers and their indices
Handle the case when the target is zero
explanation: This variant requires the candidate to handle the case when the target is zero and the array contains negative numbers.
